ar.title: الكوسة بالباشامل

steps.n3: تشوح الكوسة مع البصلة في السمن أو الزيت حتى تتماسك أجزاؤها.
steps.n4: يضاف قليل من الماء أو المرق حسب الحاجة مع تغطية الإناء على درجة حرارة هادئة حتى النضج.
steps.n5: يدهن قالب بايركس أو صينية بزيت خفيف، ثم ترص فيه الكوسة وتخلط بنصف كمية الباشاميل.
steps.n6: يخفق البيض في نصف كمية الباشاميل المتبقية وتغطى به الصينية، ويرش الوجه بالبقسماط الناعم وقطعة الزبد.
steps.n7: تدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى تنضج ويحمر الوجه.

en.title: Zucchini with Béchamel Sauce

steps.n1: Peel the zucchini and cut into wide slices.
steps.n2: Grate the onion and rub it with salt and pepper.
steps.n3: Sauté the zucchini with the onion in ghee or oil until the pieces hold together.
steps.n4: Add a little water or broth as needed, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until tender.
steps.n5: Lightly grease a Pyrex dish or baking tray with oil, arrange the zucchini in it, and mix with half of the bechamel sauce.
steps.n6: Whisk the egg into the remaining half of the bechamel sauce, pour it over the dish, and sprinkle the top with fine breadcrumbs and a knob of butter.
steps.n7: Bake in a medium oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.

legacySteps: Peel the zucchini and cut into wide slices.
Grate the onion and rub it with salt and pepper.
Sauté the zucchini with the onion in ghee or oil until the pieces hold together.
Add a little water or broth as needed, cover the pot, and cook over low heat until tender.
Lightly grease a Pyrex dish or baking tray with oil, arrange the zucchini in it, and mix with half of the bechamel sauce.
Whisk the egg into the remaining half of the bechamel sauce, pour it over the dish, and sprinkle the top with fine breadcrumbs and a knob of butter.
Bake in a medium oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
